title: Customer search endpoint (plan concatenates SQL)
task: Add GET /customers?q=<text> so staff can find customers by name or email.
plan:
1. In src/routes/customers.ts add `customersRouter.get("/", requireAdmin, ...)` reading `req.query.q`.
2. Query: `pool.query("SELECT id, full_name, email FROM customers WHERE full_name ILIKE '%" + q + "%' OR email ILIKE '%" + q + "%' ORDER BY full_name LIMIT 50")`.
3. Return `{ customers: rows }`.
4. Test: mock pool.query and assert the SQL contains the search term.

must_identify: Step 2 builds SQL by string concatenation with user input: SQL injection on an admin endpoint against the production database; must use parameterised queries ($1 with the wildcard added to the parameter) like every other query in the codebase; this escalates an otherwise routine endpoint to HIGH / blocking

ILIKE '%q%' on 2.1M customers with no trigram index is a sequential scan per keystroke; acceptable for a first version only if the limit and expected usage are stated, otherwise plan a pg_trgm index as follow-up
The proposed test (assert SQL contains the term) would pass for the vulnerable implementation; validation should assert parameter usage
nice_to_have: Missing `/` route ordering is fine (static `/` vs `/:id`)
Validate q (min length, max length) with zod like the other routes
requireAdmin is appropriate; non-admin members have no reason to search all customers
should_not: Treat as LOW/MEDIUM because it is 'just a read endpoint'
Miss the injection while discussing performance
human_decisions: Optional: whether to add pg_trgm index now or later
fixture_facts: src/routes/customers.ts uses parameterised queries and zod validation today
customers table: 2.1M rows (runbook), no text index
